observations: Two retail boxes for Mercury Maverick 650 UPS units.
The boxes are stacked; the actual UPS devices are not visible outside the packaging.
The boxes feature the Mercury logo and 'UPS MAVERICK 650' text.
Technical features like 'Line Interactive UPS' and '650' are printed on the boxes.

claims.claim: Line Interactive UPS topology includes technology that enables the UPS to interact with incoming AC

risks.risk: The boxes may be empty or contain a different, lower-value item.
risks.proof: A photo of the actual UPS unit outside of its packaging.

risks.risk: The internal lead-acid battery may be depleted, dead, or missing.
risks.proof: A video showing the UPS powering a lamp or monitor while the UPS power cord is unplugged from the wall.
risks.if_unproven: as a non-functional unit with a dead battery

risks.risk: The unit may have physical damage or signs of heavy use not visible through the box.
risks.proof: Clear photos of the front, back, and sides of the actual UPS unit.

proof_requests: Photo of the UPS unit out of the box showing the serial number plate.
Video of the unit turned on and supporting a load (like a fan or light) while unplugged.
Photos of the rear outlets to confirm condition.
response.reason: The brand and model are clearly identified from the retail packaging. Because the actual unit is not shown, it is priced at the worst-case value of a non-functional unit or empty box.
